comment: Every icon the program draws from Fluent UI System Icons (docs/specs/ui-refresh-plan.md, sections 4.2 and 4.3; icons/README.md). tools/New-IconData.ps1 reads this file and the SVGs in third-party/fluentui-system-icons/icons and writes CodeBase/UI/Icons/IconData.g.cs. One row per purpose. enum: the enum the row is a member of (UiGlyph: the control glyphs, generated into IconData.g.cs; EnumIcons: the toolbar and module icons, UI-7b). name: the member. fluent: the Fluent icon's file name stem (icons/<fluent>_<size>_<style>.svg), or custom: a stem under icons/custom (icons/custom/<custom>_<size>.svg). style: regular or filled. sizes: the design sizes vendored and compiled in (section 3.5: 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 48; the 24 design serves 24 to 31 px, so 28 is not used); a slot whose design is missing gets the largest smaller one, centred. role: the colour the icon is drawn in by default (Text, Accent, Danger, Success, Warning); the control may pass its own (a white check mark on the accent, the title bar's text colour on a caption button). purpose: where it is drawn.

icons.name: Dismiss
icons.purpose: caption button: close (UI-3); the close mark of tabs and panels

icons.name: ChevronUp
icons.purpose: up arrows: spin buttons, scroll buttons, collapse (UI-4a to UI-6)

icons.name: ChevronDown
icons.purpose: drop-down arrows of combo boxes, drop-down buttons and menus; expand (UI-4a to UI-6)

icons.name: ChevronLeft
icons.purpose: previous: the month calendar, tab scroll buttons (UI-4b, UI-4c)

icons.name: ChevronRight
icons.purpose: next: the month calendar, tab scroll buttons, sub-menu arrows (UI-4b, UI-4c, UI-6)

icons.name: Checkmark
icons.purpose: the check box's check mark (white on the accent) and checked menu items (UI-4a, UI-6)

icons.name: Dash
icons.purpose: the indeterminate check box's dash (white on the accent, UI-4a)
